freight.title: High-Power Hydrogen Freight Locomotive
freight.subtitle: A 2024 heavy-haul test in the Batuta corridor, Inner Mongolia
freight.photoAlt: CHN Energy's 2,400 kW hydrogen freight locomotive at the Batuta–Zhunge’er railway test site
freight.duration: Continuous operation on a full hydrogen tank, as reported
freight.scope: 10,000 tonnes refers to the full train on level track; performance depends on operating conditions. Described in the briefing material as China's highest-power hydrogen locomotive.

mining.title: Hydrogen Locomotives for Mining and Industry
mining.subtitle: Two power classes for industrial and mine railway applications
mining.smallAlt: CRRC 700 kW hydrogen shunting locomotive hauling rail cars in snow
mining.mediumAlt: CRRC 1,400 kW hydrogen locomotive photographed in an industrial workshop
mining.regions: Pilot/test regions: Liaoning · Inner Mongolia · Hebei
mining.benefit: Lower Carbon Emissions Compared with Diesel Locomotives
mining.benefitNote: Some projects estimate reductions of several hundred tonnes per locomotive annually; the outcome depends on duty cycle and hydrogen supply.
mining.scope: Regions and the annual estimate are as reported; they do not indicate commercial operation or a lifecycle benefit in every case.
